📢 We’re Hiring | Principal – CBSE School

Bara, Bikram, Patna is looking for an experienced and dynamic Principal to lead the school towards academic excellence, effective administration, and overall growth.

🎓 Position: Principal
📍 Location: Bara, Bikram, Patna, Bihar
💼 Experience: 5–10 years in teaching/administration
📚 Qualification: Post Graduate with B.Ed.
⭐ Preferred: Principal / Vice Principal / Academic Coordinator experience
🌾 Mandatory: Experience working in rural areas
🚀 Joining: Immediate / As per requirement
💰 Salary: Attractive package based on qualification & experience

Key Responsibilities

• Academic & administrative management
• Academic planning and implementation
• Staff supervision, training & performance monitoring
• Student discipline and academic improvement
• Parent communication & grievance handling
• CBSE compliance and documentation
• Examinations, activities & school events
• Creating a positive and progressive school environment

📩 Send CV: jeetprofitswipe@gmail.com
📞 Contact: 7549121548 – Jeet Raj

If you are a suitable candidate or know someone who fits this profile, feel free to connect/share this opportunity.
